9
A ball falls vertically to the floor and rebounds vertically upwards.
Just before it hits the floor, its speed is 4.0m/s.
As it rebounds, its speed is 3.0m/s.
The mass of the ball is 0.50kg.
What is the change in momentum of the ball?
A
0.50kgm/s downwards
B
0.50kgm/s upwards
C
3.5kgm/s downwards
D
3.5kgm/s upwards
subject: Physics
